parole.testo: Borrowed from French encyclopédie, from New Latin encyclopaedia (“general education”), from a univerbated form of Koine Greek ἐγκύκλιος παιδείᾱ (enkúklios paideíā, “education in the circle of arts and sciences”), from ἐγκύκλιος (enkúklios, “circular”) + παιδείᾱ (paideíā, “child-rearing, education”).

Borrowed from French cosmopolitisme, from New Latin cosmopolītismus, from Koine Greek κοσμοπολιτισμός (kosmopolitismós). With -и́зм (-ýzm) suffix. Compare Russian космополити́зм (kosmopolitízm), Belarusian касмапаліты́зм (kasmapalitýzm).
Borrowed from French molécule, from Latin molecula (“a molecule”), diminutive of moles (“a mass”).
